description:
Noted while landing fz-f98.21: sigs.rs documents MapSig::intersect_pos as
never returning PosMeet::Empty (measured-and-left), so same-axis positive map
sigs never collapse or refute at meet time; the map axis relies on
map_clause_empty alone. canon's union-level subsumption drop covers the
comparison boundary, but production intersections can pile up conjunctive map
structure the way fz-go4.24 fixed for the other axes. If map-heavy traffic
grows, this is the axis with no clause-level normalization. Verify cost with a
map-heavy fixture before investing.
title: Map axis has no clause-level normalization: MapSig::intersect_pos never reports Empty
